title: ZDR run tombstone (WS4.J)
description: The ONLY fields a Zero Data Retention run tombstone may carry: ids, closed-vocabulary classes, counts and timestamps. It never carries a URL, host, title, query, user id, content, digest, fingerprint or free text, and a value that contains '://' is refused. Authored data owned by Quarry; the edge serializer (crates/quarry-edge/src/zdr_tombstone.rs), the quarry-control handler (internal/resources/zdr_tombstone.go) and the migration (015_zdr_run_tombstones.sql) are each tested to name exactly these keys and these vocabularies. OFF BY DEFAULT: counsel review gates enabling the tombstone, not building it.
